description: Destination Lens (F8 Deep, Req 14) and the In-Stay Sentinel (Part C, Req 15 Checkout Shield Deep + Req 17-21): place-entity extraction + geocoding + destination heatmap + Evidence Packet PDF; multi-channel complaint intake, triage/routing, resolution tracking + recurrence, the live Checkout Shield risk board, the WhatsApp gateway (mock) live Hinglish demo loop, and minimal voice complaints. All surfaced as website pages with live updates.
steps: Destination_Lens (Req 14) in app/services/destination_lens/: on review storage extract Place_Entities (incl. Hinglish + Devanagari place names); geocode via the curated Mussoorie/Uttarakhand gazetteer first then an optional external geocoder, storing lat/lon + resolution confidence; compute Hotspots (negative mentions per geocoded entity/grid cell over a period). Website /destination page: a heatmap of negative mentions per Hotspot filterable by issue theme (traffic, parking, water, garbage, road condition, safety) and date range (use a map lib such as react-leaflet with OSM tiles).

Evidence_Packet_Generator (Req 14.4-14.8): a destination_official selecting a Hotspot + theme produces an Evidence_Packet PDF within 30s (use reportlab/weasyprint) containing title, Destination, date range, monthly trend chart, total mention count, count of distinct Properties whose guests mention the issue, a map excerpt, and >=5 quotes with platform+date+source URL; Hindi option renders headings/summary in Devanagari with a Hindi translation beneath each original-language quote; exclude pseudonyms + guest PII; record each generated packet as an issue surfaced to authorities (issues-surfaced metric).

Sentinel domain models (app/models/): Stay (guest pseudonym, room, check-in/checkout datetime, purpose, party composition, preferences), Complaint (channel, linked Stay, timestamps, department, urgency, issue type, SOP, state, recurrence link), SOP (per-Property: department, issue type, corrective steps, target resolution time), Department + Urgency enums.

Multi-channel intake (Req 17) in app/services/sentinel/intake.py: accept Complaints from in_person, whatsapp, feedback_form, review_platform, concierge; WhatsApp complaint from a number linked to an in-house Stay creates a Complaint on that Stay; front-desk free-text in any supported language; a negative Review_Record matched to a Stay checked out within 14 days creates a review_platform Complaint; record creation timestamp.

Triage_Engine (Req 18) in app/services/sentinel/triage.py: assign Department + Urgency + issue type + matching SOP within 5s; notify the assigned department via Dashboard (and WhatsApp where configured); record complaint-to-department time; distinguish Housekeeping (cleanliness/linen/towels/amenities) vs Maintenance (plumbing/electrical/heating/geyser/Wi-Fi hardware); safety/medical/fire/security terms in any language -> P1; department confidence <0.6 -> route to Front_Office for manual assignment; record reassignments + original prediction; show SOP steps + target time with each complaint.

Resolution + recurrence (Req 19): mark-resolved records timestamp + note; compute in-stay resolution rate (resolved before checkout); a new complaint matching an earlier complaint's issue type for the same room within 30 days or same Stay -> mark Recurrence + link earlier + raise Urgency one level (max P1); exceed SOP target without resolution -> escalate to managers; website shows complaint-to-department time, in-stay resolution rate, repeat-complaint count per week. Metamorphic test seed for 15.7 lives with Risk_Scorer.

F3 Risk_Scorer + Checkout_Shield (Req 15) in app/services/sentinel/risk.py + /checkout-shield page: compute a Risk_Score [0,1] per in-house Stay from its Complaints (count, urgency, open/resolved, recurrence), message sentiment, time-to-checkout, Stay attributes; recompute within 10s of a complaint create/update/resolve; board sorts by Risk_Score desc showing room, guest pseudonym, checkout countdown, score, top open complaint, responsible department, SOP action; score>=0.6 highlights + notifies managers; score>=0.6 AND <4h to checkout pins to top; board updates within 5s without manual refresh (websocket or SSE/polling); metamorphic property: resolving an open complaint (others fixed) never increases the score (test); show top-3 contributing factors; document validation AUC + calibration on a held-out dataset in the repo.

WhatsApp_Gateway live Hinglish demo (Req 20) using the mock gateway from FEAT-001: inbound webhook -> Sentinel within 5s; a Hinglish complaint (e.g. 'room mein geyser kaam nahi kar raha') appears on the Checkout Shield with updated Risk_Score within 15s; triaged WhatsApp complaint sends the guest an acknowledgement in their language naming the responsible department; webhook failing HMAC signature verification -> HTTP 403 + Audit_Log entry. Provide a demo helper that simulates an inbound WhatsApp message so the loop is demonstrable with no live provider.

F4 Voice complaints minimal (Req 21) in app/services/sentinel/voice via the Voice_Pipeline adapter: a WhatsApp voice note up to 2 min is transcribed + language-detected (stub/local impl); non-English transcript gets an English translation, both stored on the Complaint; triaged voice complaint replies to the guest in text in the detected language; transcription confidence <0.5 -> flag for staff + route to Front_Office; support at least Hindi, English and one more Indian language in the demo.

Expose Sentinel + Destination routers (app/api/routers/) and build the themed website pages /destination, /checkout-shield (live board), /complaints (queue, triage, resolution, recurrence). Add pytest tests for intake, triage rules (incl. P1 safety + <0.6 fallback), recurrence + escalation, the Risk_Scorer monotonicity metamorphic property, the heatmap/evidence-packet content, and the WhatsApp signature-403 path.
acceptance_criteria: Destination Lens extracts + geocodes place entities (gazetteer-first) and the website heatmap filters by theme + date range.
Evidence_Packet PDF generates within 30s with all required sections, a Hindi (Devanagari) mode with per-quote translations, no pseudonyms/PII, and increments the issues-surfaced metric.
Complaints are accepted from all five channels, review->Stay matching within 14 days creates a review_platform complaint, and creation timestamps are recorded.

Triage assigns department/urgency/issue-type/SOP within 5s, forces P1 on safety/medical/fire/security terms in any language, routes <0.6-confidence to Front_Office, distinguishes Housekeeping vs Maintenance, and records reassignments with the original prediction (tested).

Resolution tracking records timestamps/notes, computes the in-stay resolution rate, detects recurrence (same room <=30 days or same Stay) raising urgency one level to max P1, and escalates SOP-overrun complaints to managers.

Checkout Shield computes Risk_Scores, recomputes within 10s of complaint changes, sorts/highlights/pins per the >=0.6 and <4h rules, updates the board within 5s without refresh, shows top-3 factors, and satisfies the resolve-does-not-increase-score metamorphic test; AUC + calibration documented.

A simulated inbound Hinglish WhatsApp complaint reaches the Checkout Shield with an updated score within the time budget, the guest gets a language-matched acknowledgement naming the department, and a bad-signature webhook returns 403 + an Audit_Log entry.

Voice notes are transcribed + language-detected with translation stored, low-confidence (<0.5) ones flagged + routed to Front_Office, replies sent in the detected language, covering Hindi/English + one more language.
The website exposes themed /destination, /checkout-shield (live) and /complaints pages.
verification: Run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` and confirm Sentinel + Destination unit + metamorphic tests pass.
Run the WhatsApp demo helper to simulate an inbound Hinglish complaint and confirm it surfaces on the Checkout Shield (via API/state) within the time budget.
Run `cd frontend && npm run build && npm test` and confirm the destination, checkout-shield and complaints pages build and render.
